title: Best Hosting Under ₹100
description: The best budget hosting under ₹100/month with renewal costs fully exposed.
intro: We tested 14 budget providers to find the sweet spot between extreme affordability and technical reliability. Hidden renewal fees are the real trap here - the advertised ₹69 Hostinger plan becomes ₹159/mo at renewal. Here's the raw data.
renewalWarning: Advertised prices require 36-48 month prepayment. Renewal rates run 76-151% higher.

technicalTradeoffs.title: Resource Limits
technicalTradeoffs.text: While advertised as 'unlimited bandwidth', you are strictly bound by CPU and RAM limits - often 1 Core / 768MB RAM in this tier.

technicalTradeoffs.title: Noisy Neighbors
technicalTradeoffs.text: Shared environments at this price point mean another site's traffic spike can temporarily slow your TTFB.

technicalTradeoffs.title: The 48-Month Catch
technicalTradeoffs.text: The advertised ₹69 price requires paying for 4 years upfront. Shorter terms push the price well over ₹100.

faqs.question: Is a free domain included under ₹100?
faqs.answer: Rarely on the lowest tier plans. Hostinger's Single Web (₹69) does not include a free domain, but their Premium Web (usually ~₹149) does. You'll typically need to purchase a domain separately.

faqs.question: What happens after the initial term expires?
faqs.answer: You'll be billed at the standard renewal rate, typically 2x to 3x higher than the introductory offer. Always check the renewal price in our comparison table before committing to a 4-year plan.

faqs.question: Can I run WordPress under ₹100?
faqs.answer: Yes - Hostinger's ₹69 plan handles WordPress fine for a static portfolio or dev sandbox. Don't run a busy WooCommerce store on it; you'll hit CPU limits quickly.

title: Best Hosting Under ₹200
description: The sweet spot for budget hosting under ₹200/month - a real performance jump over entry plans.
intro: Crossing ₹200/month unlocks dramatically better hosting: 1-2 CPU cores, 2-4GB RAM, and genuine NVMe storage. This is our recommended budget tier for most small businesses and growing blogs in India.
renewalWarning: At this tier, quality jumps significantly - prioritize providers with transparent renewal pricing.

technicalTradeoffs.title: Real NVMe Storage
technicalTradeoffs.text: At this tier, NVMe drives replace SSDs - expect 5-10x faster disk I/O for WordPress and database workloads.

technicalTradeoffs.title: LiteSpeed Advantages
technicalTradeoffs.text: Hostinger and A2's Turbo plans use LiteSpeed, which dramatically lowers TTFB and LCP for PHP sites.

technicalTradeoffs.title: Better Renewal Value
technicalTradeoffs.text: Renewal jumps are still present, but the underlying plan is capable enough to justify staying long-term.

faqs.question: What's the best hosting under ₹200?
faqs.answer: Hostinger's Premium Web plan at ₹149/mo is the best value. It includes 100GB NVMe storage, unlimited websites, free domain, and a free SSL.

faqs.question: Is ₹200/month enough for a business website?
faqs.answer: Yes. At this tier you get 2+ CPU cores and enough RAM to comfortably run WordPress, WooCommerce (small catalogs), and moderate traffic.

faqs.question: Should I pay upfront for 4 years?
faqs.answer: Only if you're confident you'll stay. The introductory price requires long-term prepayment; you lose flexibility if you outgrow the plan.

title: Best Hosting Under ₹500
description: Serious performance under ₹500/month - cloud VPS territory with real headroom.
intro: ₹500/month is where cloud VPS hosting becomes accessible in India. This tier delivers 2-4 vCPUs, 4-8GB RAM, and the performance headroom to run multiple sites, staging environments, and heavier WooCommerce stores.
renewalWarning: VPS pricing is transparent (no intro-vs-renewal games). Managed hosts bundle support and backups into the monthly price.

technicalTradeoffs.title: True Dedicated Resources
technicalTradeoffs.text: VPS hosting at this tier isolates your CPU and RAM - no noisy neighbors on shared servers.

technicalTradeoffs.title: Full Root Access
technicalTradeoffs.text: Install any software stack: Docker, Node.js, Python, Nginx, or a custom firewall.

technicalTradeoffs.title: Managed vs Unmanaged
technicalTradeoffs.text: Cloudways bundles managed support for ~₹590/mo extra. If you can admin a server, Vultr at ₹400/mo is unbeatable value.

faqs.question: What's the best VPS under ₹500?
faqs.answer: Vultr's 2GB instance at ~₹400/mo is the best raw value. Hostinger's KVM 2 VPS adds a control panel at ₹449/mo. Cloudways exceeds ₹500 once you add managed support.

faqs.question: Can I host multiple websites on a VPS?
faqs.answer: Yes. A 2GB VPS comfortably runs 5-10 low-to-medium traffic WordPress sites using Docker or Nginx virtual hosts.

faqs.question: Do I need managed hosting at this price?
faqs.answer: Only if you don't want to handle updates, security, and backups yourself. Unmanaged VPS at ₹400/mo is a massive step up from shared hosting for the same price as a coffee.

title: Best Hosting Under ₹1000
description: Premium managed hosting and powerful VPS plans under ₹1000/month.
intro: At ₹1,000/month you can afford premium managed WordPress hosting or a serious production VPS. Kinsta's entry plan, Cloudways on AWS, and high-end Vultr instances all fit in this budget - the choice comes down to managed convenience versus raw control.
renewalWarning: Managed hosts in this tier are month-to-month with transparent pricing - renewal surprises are rare.

technicalTradeoffs.title: Managed WordPress Peak
technicalTradeoffs.text: Kinsta's entry plan at ~₹2,900/mo (under budget if you only need one site) includes Cloudflare edge caching and premium support.

technicalTradeoffs.title: Production VPS Power
technicalTradeoffs.text: A 4GB NVMe droplet or Vultr instance at ~₹960/mo runs production apps, databases, and staging environments comfortably.

technicalTradeoffs.title: Scaling Headroom
technicalTradeoffs.text: This tier includes horizontal scaling paths - snapshots, load balancers, and managed databases become affordable.

faqs.question: What can I get for ₹1000/month?
faqs.answer: A production-grade VPS (DigitalOcean/Vultr 4GB), Cloudways on AWS with managed support, or the entry tier of premium managed WordPress hosting.

faqs.question: Managed hosting or VPS at this price?
faqs.answer: Choose managed (Kinsta/Cloudways) if your time is valuable and you want hands-off operations. Choose a VPS if you want full control and will admin the server yourself.

faqs.question: Is ₹1000/month overkill for a small site?
faqs.answer: For a single small site, yes - ₹100-200/month shared hosting is enough. ₹1000/month makes sense for businesses, multiple sites, or applications with real traffic.
